title: US Commerce finalizing rule to block Chinese AI remote chip access
summary: The US Commerce Department is finalizing a rule that would bar Chinese AI companies from remotely using advanced AI chips through data centers outside China, according to The Information. The measure would extend existing semiconductor export restrictions to seven countries, including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, to close remote-access and smuggling gaps. Commerce is consulting other agencies and could publish the rule as soon as this month, but the report gives no rule text, effective date or exemption details. Nvidia reportedly lobbied against closing the remote-access gap, arguing that US AI infrastructure needs to win globally.
